article.title: What’s the matter with Connecticut?
article.excerpt: Despite being the richest state in the country, by per-capita income, Connecticut’s budget is a mess. Its pensions are woefully under-funded . Its deficit is projected to surpass $2 billion , or 12 percent of its total annual tax revenue. Hartford is approaching bankruptcy .
